summary_claims.claim: AI Office of Ireland (Oifig IS na hÉireann) established as statutory body
amends the Central Bank Act 1942 and the Competition and Consumer Protection Act 2014

note: The Act and S.I. Nos. 403 and 404 from the Irish Statute Book are the instrument's own text, so level A is right. Partial commencement matches the order. Search found no amending act; a law firm mentions a separate designation instrument, whose text I did not find, and the notes already say further legislation is planned.
